# R000B native instrument preparation evidence

This packet preserves the actual preparation history for the R000B no-timetable
weather-withdrawal experiment. It contains the original HN1–HN4 findings and
repairs, v2 preparation review, the healthy-refresh extension, the v3 HR1/HR2
contrary evidence, the corrected interfaces and independent v4 closure review.
The original failures remain failures of their original instruments.

The current fixture, driver and portable pure controls are at their normal
repository paths. M2 expected manifests supersede M1 for the corrected driver;
their 142-file runtime inventories, authored sources and embedded scripts are
unchanged. Neither expected manifest is an observation of a browser run.

These are contained source-interface and pure predicate checks. No native
browser run, live provider result, pixel acceptance, coherent remote candidate,
ordered integration, merge or issue closure is established by this packet.
The eventual native statuses still require original screenshots/video and
independent review. Exact capture-before-render ordering is a source control;
native acquisition observes an ordinary healthy refresh without forcing it.

Each copied report retains its original scope and then-current statements.
Original scripts/logs retain the absolute paths of the acquisition workspace;
they are historical evidence, not instructions to overwrite a checkout or
authorization to rerun external actions. The portable repository tests can be
run directly; adapting a historical scratch probe requires explicit input and
path binding. The adjacent manifest binds every copied byte. It supplies
custody, not a new test result or acceptance authority.
